name: Brick Controller
description: Bluetooth HID gamepad for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Pro: PC, Xbox, PS4 and Switch identities, on-device settings, no host driver. Brick Pro support is not yet hardware-validated; Smart Pro is not supported.
author: Brick Controller contributors

changelog.v1.1.0: Adds a Settings screen with D-Pad Mode (D-Pad or Left Stick) and Rumble strength (Off, Low, Mid, Strong). Preferences persist across restarts. Refreshes the disconnect overlay and controller hints.
changelog.v1.0.0: First public release. Bluetooth HID gamepad for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Pro, with PC, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch identities. Brick Pro support is implemented but not yet hardware-validated. Smart Pro is refused at startup.
